name: GreyboxPlacerWindow
src_typeComment: Window > Toolkit > Greybox Placer: click in the Scene view (in Edit mode, not Play mode) to stamp grid-snapped blocks for fast 3D level blockouts. This is deliberately NOT a ProBuilder replacement — it stamps whole prefabs/primitives, it doesn't edit meshes (no vertices/faces/extrude/boolean). Use this for the rough "shape of the level" pass, then ProBuilder (or real art) for anything beyond simple stamped blocks. Requires a collider somewhere in the scene (e.g. a ground plane) for the placement raycast to hit.
